ImageDescription.value: This photo shows a beautifully plated seafood dish. The main component appears to be a perfectly cooked piece of salmon with a nicely seared, seasoned crust topped with several large pink shrimp. The dish is served with what looks like pasta or noodles on the side and steamed broccoli. There are also some green onions or chives sprinkled as a garnish. The food is presented on a white plate, and the photo is taken with a shallow depth of field that focuses on the seafood while gently blurring the background. This looks like a delicious restaurant-quality meal combining the richness of salmon with the delicate flavor of shrimp.

Super simple quick bento with leftovers from last night's takeout dinner

Top tier: rice drizzled with teriyaki sauce, molded into a heart-shaped onigiri; teriyaki salmon; peapods and tomatoes (red grape tomatoes sitting on top of green tomatoes); froggy soy sauce bottle.

ImageDescription.value:
onigiri stuffed with salmon and wasabi mayo, topped with an orange-food-coloring-dyed egg sheet and nori cut-outs. surrounded by yellow wax beans and yellow tomato, enoki mushrooms, radish "mushroom," veggie croquettes with carrot-takuwan-sesame flower accents, purple broccoli and purple cauliflower, edamame in a food cup with takuwan and red grape tomato on a spider foodpick, and snow peas in the bottom right.

clickety click chopsticks and a strawberry-choco lolly for good measure!

ObjectName.value: Spooky cat onigiri bento (4054741302)

Categories.value: Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Files from bento box Flickr group uploaded by Netha Hussain

ImageDescription.value:
last halloween bento, as we are away this weekend for a friend's wedding. hope you all have a wonderful holiday!

another salmon-and-wasabi mayo onigiri, this time in the shape of a spooky cat, with purple-food coloring-dyed egg sheet, cheese head, takuwan-sesame eyes, and nori nose/mouth.

from top left: carved jack-o-lantern mini pepper, simmered kabocha squash with edamame on a pumpkin food pick, two fish pajun (korean pancakes), carrot-sesame flowers, "BOO" quail eggs (nori letters), snow peas, and purple broccoli in a silicone food cup.
